address: Central Suffolk and North Ipswich, Suffolk,IP8 4AZ
bio: Take relaxation to a whole new level with a spa day for two at Riverhills in Ipswich. Enjoy the serene ambience of this health club and boutique spa, which is worlds apart from any stresses and strains of everyday life. Make the most of the state-of-the-art facilities, which include a swimming pool, spa bath, sauna, steam room, gym and aromatherapy rooms. Once you’ve spent some time unwinding, you’ll be treated to a delicious afternoon tea, comprised of freshly-prepared finger sandwiches, fruit scones with clotted cream and preserves and a fine selection of sweet treats and cakes, all washed down with your choice of freshly-brewed coffee or tea. This spa day is the perfect excuse to escape it all and indulge in a little relaxation
